name: Solar Beto Carrero Hotel
description: The official on-site hotel at Beto Carrero World — Solar Beto Carrero Hotel is the most convenient and immersive accommodation option for park visitors, offering comfortable rooms, a pool, multiple dining options and direct access to Brazil's largest theme park. The best option for families wanting maximum time at Beto Carrero World.

name: Costão do Santinho Resort
description: One of Santa Catarina's most prestigious beach resorts — Costão do Santinho is a magnificent 5-star resort on a pristine Atlantic beach near Florianópolis, 45 minutes from Beto Carrero World. Featuring beautiful rooms, multiple pools, a full spa, water sports and award-winning restaurants.

name: Marambaia Beach Resort
description: A comfortable and well-located beach resort near Penha and Beto Carrero World — Marambaia offers attractive rooms, a pool, restaurant and easy access to the park and Santa Catarina's beautiful beaches. One of the most popular accommodation options for Beto Carrero World visitors.

name: Pousada Penha
description: A charming and affordable pousada in Penha, just minutes from Beto Carrero World — offering clean comfortable rooms, a pool and a friendly Brazilian atmosphere. The best budget accommodation option for visitors to Beto Carrero World.
